requirement.value: Rogue, Sharpshooter, Prizefighter (Weaponmaster) or Bounty Hunter mastery + High Speed

system.description: A High Speed free attack with a bow, spear or thrown weapon deals extra damage equal to (your Skill Level in High Speed × 5). And when you attack one or more creatures with a bow, spear or thrown weapon, those creatures cannot perform free attacks until the end of the current turn.
